style.backgroundSystem: warm off-white #FAF7F2 and cream matte surfaces for editorial shots, pure white #FFFFFF for packshot info cards, periwinkle #7C87B5 reserved for the closing panel
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons inside thin gold circle outlines #C9862B, single accent color
style.lightingSystem: soft warm directional daylight-style key (front-left or side), gentle fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft warm knitwear e-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm off-white background #FAF7F2, charcoal text #2D2D2D, periwinkle blue-grey accent #7C87B5 and honey gold secondary accent #C9862B; soft warm directional daylight-style lighting with gentle fill and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines only; consistent rounded rectangular info cards and labels; consistent thin-line icon style; clean editorial product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable gentle 3/4 and overhead product angles, consistent knit-texture rendering, centered stable placement
style.surfaceSystem: matte magazine pages, soft fur rug, neutral matte board
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines only, Chinese text wrapped in 「」, charcoal #2D2D2D as the default text color
